m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I sense a light in your heart. Is this so?
We would help you then, Light Bringer, but we are the barest of memories.
We came here to find a weapon to use against the Shadow Queen, but her minion, Papa Jacobo, consumed us.
The door to the upper chamber is locked, but the key is hidden in this room. Take it, and blast Papa Jacobo to a memory!
<ITALICS>At the edge of the room, you see several Mantis spirits flickering in and out. They seem greatly agitated. </ITALICS>
I'm hungry, feeding on chaos and living in Shadow! Where do I begin? I'll cut your life into pieces!
I never realized I was spread too thin! Celestial Phoenix? She's long destroyed. All that is left is this petrified egg!
<ITALICS>You find the Egg that Papa Jacobo mentioned. It certainly seems petrified. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>There's no other signs of a living Phoenix. You hope Amelia StarDust can use this Egg, somehow. <ITALICS>
The Celestial Phoenix was gone? That is dire news! But let me see this Egg you speak of.
I think... if I am right, all is far from lost. Place the rekindled Starstuff there, at the center point.
The last Nova Tower is devoted to the Celestial Phoenix. Be careful, Spellbinder, for I sense a dark Shadow in that place.
Find the Celestial Phoenix and convince her to return with you here.
Go to the Celestial Phoenix Tower and search for the Celestial Phoenix. Find her, and ask her to return with you here.
